label: H.R. 3106
title: Weatherizing Infrastructure in the North and Terrorism Emergency Readiness Act of 2025

items.snippet: This bill requires the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to develop and conduct an exercise to enhance collective domestic preparedness for and response to a…

Within 60 days after completion of the exercise, DHS must submit to Congress an after-action report including the initial findings of the exercise, plans for incorporating lessons learned into future operations, and any proposed legislative changes.
